verdict.rationale: Replit's marketing says apps can connect to Stripe, OpenAI, Google Workspace and '100+ integrations' in minutes, and admins can set up connectors once for builders to reuse across apps. Built-in auth, database and hosting, plus Agent-written code, imply backend logic can be added from the builder. However, server-side functions are never documented as an explicit feature. The Stripe MCP items mainly cover giving Agent context rather than wiring payments into the app itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of server-side functions or API endpoints, any evidence of email-sending integrations, step-by-step docs for adding payments to an app, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
